result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: a meaningless '-0%' discount badge on the lower card. The rest of the page renders cleanly, excluding the intentionally scrollable/clipped edge content.

issues.description: The discount badge on the lower pizza card in 'Popular right now' reads '-0%', which is a nonsensical negative-zero promotion and looks like a broken placeholder/calculation.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount is 0%, and fix the discount calculation/formatting so a valid value such as '-20%' is only shown when a real promotion applies.
